_comment: ATIVE UAS Bot - Emergency Recovery Version
name: ATIVE UAS Bot - Emergency
author: support@ative.com
description: Emergency recovery egg that forces fresh clone and proper file structure

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Emergency UAS Bot Recovery Installation
echo "=== EMERGENCY UAS BOT RECOVERY ==="

# Install system dependencies
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config
apt install -y default-mysql-client

# Update npm
echo "Updating npm..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

# Ensure clean slate
echo "Preparing clean installation directory..."
rm -rf /mnt/server/*
rm -rf /mnt/server/.*
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Force fresh clone
echo "Force cloning latest repository..."
GIT_REPO="https://github.com/talmax1124/Ative-Casino-Bot.git"
git clone --depth=1 --single-branch --branch main $GIT_REPO temp_repo

# Extract UAS files to server root
echo "Extracting UAS bot files..."
if [ -d "temp_repo/uas" ]; then
    cp -r temp_repo/uas/* /mnt/server/
    rm -rf temp_repo
    echo "UAS files extracted successfully"
else
    echo "ERROR: UAS directory not found in repository"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify critical files
echo "Verifying file structure..."
if [ ! -f "index.js" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: index.js not found"
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "UTILS" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: UTILS directory not found"
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "UTILS/logger.js" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: UTILS/logger.js not found"
    exit 1
fi
echo "File structure verified successfully"

# Install dependencies
echo "Installing Node.js dependencies..."
if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    npm install
    echo "Dependencies installed from package.json"
else
    echo "ERROR: package.json not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Create logs directory
mkdir -p logs

echo "=== UAS Bot Emergency Installation Complete ==="
exit 0
